title: Certifying Provenance of Scientific Datasets with Self-sovereign Identity and Verifiable Credentials
reasoning: The paper's primary motivating example and use case is the certification of an ethical claim, specifically whether a dataset has been 'ethically sourced'. This concept is introduced in the abstract and used consistently throughout the paper to illustrate the proposed technical mechanism. This makes the evaluation and certification of an ethical property a central component of the work, not merely a brief 'Ethical Considerations' section.
